learning_design.unlock_rule: A knowledge node unlocks after all required prompts are revealed.
learning_design.mastery_note: Exploration progress is not mastery evidence; quiz attempts remain the scored retrieval signal.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: AWS evaluates applicable policies and context to determine whether __________.

reveal.text: AWS evaluates applicable policies and context to determine whether a request is allowed.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: An applicable explicit __________.

reveal.text: An applicable explicit deny overrides allows.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Keep identity verification separate __________.

reveal.text: Keep identity verification separate from permission evaluation.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Roles provide temporary credentials to trusted principals/services instead __________.

reveal.text: Roles provide temporary credentials to trusted principals/services instead of long-lived user keys.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Both sides matter __________.

reveal.text: Both sides matter for role access.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: EC2 needs AWS API access without stored keys → __________.

reveal.text: IAM role. Give the EC2 workload temporary AWS credentials without storing long-term access keys.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Resource-based policies specify which principals may access that resource __________.

reveal.text: Resource-based policies specify which principals may access that resource and under what conditions.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use the resource policy model when __________.

reveal.text: Use the resource policy model when the service/resource supports it.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Evaluate the complete policy context rather than assuming __________.

reveal.text: Evaluate the complete policy context rather than assuming only one policy applies.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Condition keys restrict when a policy statement applies, based on context such as __________.

reveal.text: Condition keys restrict when a policy statement applies, based on context such as tags, source, organization, or MFA.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Conditions let you enforce __________.

reveal.text: Conditions let you enforce contextual access rules.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: It narrows when __________.

reveal.text: It narrows when a statement applies.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: MFA requires an additional factor beyond __________.

reveal.text: MFA requires an additional factor beyond the primary credential.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Protect high-impact access paths __________.

reveal.text: Protect high-impact access paths with strong authentication.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Strong authentication and authorization __________.

reveal.text: Strong authentication and authorization controls are complementary.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Access Analyzer helps identify resource access and validate IAM __________.

reveal.text: Access Analyzer helps identify resource access and validate IAM policies using policy analysis.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Define/analyze trusted access boundaries __________.

reveal.text: Define/analyze trusted access boundaries and investigate findings.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Access Analyzer: policy/access analysis | CloudTrail: __________

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: The policy simulator evaluates policy behavior __________.

reveal.text: The policy simulator evaluates policy behavior for specified requests.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Use simulation plus actual request context __________.

reveal.text: Use simulation plus actual request context and audit history.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Interpret results within the __________.

reveal.text: Interpret results within the complete authorization model.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: CloudTrail records AWS API activity that helps __________.

reveal.text: CloudTrail records AWS API activity that helps investigate access and changes.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Who changed this policy?” → __________.

reveal.text: AWS CloudTrail. Use its API activity history to investigate who changed the policy.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Use IAM analysis tools/policy evaluation __________.

reveal.text: Use IAM analysis tools/policy evaluation for that question.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Organizations groups accounts into organizational units __________.

reveal.text: Organizations groups accounts into organizational units and supports centralized governance.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Organizations is the foundation for __________.

reveal.text: Organizations is the foundation for many multi-account controls.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: It groups AWS __________.

reveal.text: It groups AWS accounts, not users.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Identity/resource policies still need to __________.

reveal.text: Identity/resource policies still need to allow an action; SCPs limit what can be allowed.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: SCP: organization-level guardrail; limits permissions | IAM policy: __________

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Prevent member accounts from using service/Region even if admins allow it” → __________.

reveal.text: Service control policy (SCP). Use it as an organization-level permissions guardrail for member accounts.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: IAM Identity Center centralizes workforce identities/assignments __________.

reveal.text: IAM Identity Center centralizes workforce identities/assignments and single sign-on access.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: IAM Identity Center is a strong __________.

reveal.text: IAM Identity Center is a strong multi-account workforce-access pattern.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Identity Center is mainly __________.

reveal.text: Identity Center is mainly for workforce access; workloads generally use roles.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Trusted Advisor surfaces recommendations in areas including security, resilience, performance, cost, and __________.

reveal.text: Trusted Advisor surfaces recommendations in areas including security, resilience, performance, cost, and service limits depending on support/features.

prompts.label: ⚡ ACTION
prompts.placeholder: Recheck/confirm the issue __________.

reveal.text: Recheck/confirm the issue is resolved.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: AWS Config provides __________.

reveal.text: AWS Config provides configuration recording/evaluation capabilities.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS Config tracks configuration state/changes and can __________.

reveal.text: AWS Config tracks configuration state/changes and can evaluate resources using rules.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Configuration history and compliance evaluation are core __________.

reveal.text: Configuration history and compliance evaluation are core AWS Config use cases.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Use them together to understand what changed and __________.

reveal.text: Use them together to understand what changed and who initiated the change.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Conformance packs package a set of Config rules and remediation actions __________.

reveal.text: Conformance packs package a set of Config rules and remediation actions for deployment as a unit.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Conformance packs help standardize __________.

reveal.text: Conformance packs help standardize AWS Config-based compliance.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Continuously evaluate a collection of compliance controls” → __________.

reveal.text: AWS Config rules or conformance packs. Use them to continuously evaluate a collection of compliance controls.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Classification informs encryption, retention, access, monitoring __________.

reveal.text: Classification informs encryption, retention, access, monitoring, and handling controls.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: Use an organization-defined classification scheme tied __________.

reveal.text: Use an organization-defined classification scheme tied to handling requirements.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Data protection is __________.

reveal.text: Data protection is layered.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: AWS KMS manages keys used by many AWS services for encryption __________.

reveal.text: AWS KMS manages keys used by many AWS services for encryption and signing use cases.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Envelope encryption commonly uses data keys __________.

reveal.text: Envelope encryption commonly uses data keys protected by KMS keys.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: “Customer-controlled encryption key, rotation, audit of key use” → __________.

reveal.text: AWS KMS. Use customer-controlled KMS keys when the scenario emphasizes key control, rotation, and audit of key use.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Authorization depends on the key policy __________.

reveal.text: Authorization depends on the key policy and applicable permission mechanisms/context.

prompts.label: 🔍 LOOK FOR
prompts.placeholder: The caller/service must also be allowed to use the key for __________.

reveal.text: The caller/service must also be allowed to use the key for the required cryptographic operation.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Encryption-key permissions are a __________.

reveal.text: Encryption-key permissions are a separate authorization layer.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: ACM manages public/private certificates used by __________.

reveal.text: ACM manages public/private certificates used by supported integrated services.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: ACM is designed to simplify certificate __________.

reveal.text: ACM is designed to simplify certificate lifecycle for supported integrations.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Use the control that matches __________.

reveal.text: Use the control that matches the data-protection layer.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Secrets Manager provides managed secret storage and access, with rotation __________.

reveal.text: Secrets Manager provides managed secret storage and access, with rotation features for supported patterns.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Secrets Manager is a direct clue when rotation __________.

reveal.text: Secrets Manager is a direct clue when rotation is a core requirement.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Retrieve secrets securely at runtime __________.

reveal.text: Retrieve secrets securely at runtime with least-privilege access.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Secrets Manager: secret lifecycle and rotation-focused capabilities | Parameter Store: __________

reveal.text: Secrets Manager.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Also consider integration __________.

reveal.text: Also consider integration and cost/operational requirements.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Macie helps identify sensitive data and security __________.

reveal.text: Macie helps identify sensitive data and security issues in Amazon S3.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon Macie is __________.

reveal.text: Amazon Macie is the direct clue.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: GuardDuty focuses on threat detection __________.

reveal.text: GuardDuty focuses on threat detection from security telemetry.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: GuardDuty analyzes supported logs/signals to identify __________.

reveal.text: GuardDuty analyzes supported logs/signals to identify suspicious or malicious activity.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: GuardDuty is a common __________.

reveal.text: GuardDuty is a common managed threat-detection answer.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Integrate findings with response __________.

reveal.text: Integrate findings with response workflows as appropriate.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Inspector helps identify package vulnerabilities and __________.

reveal.text: Inspector helps identify package vulnerabilities and supported exposure risks.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: Amazon Inspector is __________.

reveal.text: Amazon Inspector is the direct clue.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Inspector: vulnerability/exposure management | GuardDuty: __________

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Security Hub provides a centralized view of findings and security __________.

reveal.text: Security Hub provides a centralized view of findings and security posture from supported services/integrations.

prompts.label: ⏱️ WHEN?
prompts.placeholder: AWS Security __________.

reveal.text: AWS Security Hub.

prompts.label: 🚫 NOT THIS
prompts.placeholder: Understand where a finding originates and __________.

reveal.text: Understand where a finding originates and where remediation belongs.

prompts.label: ❓ WHAT?
prompts.placeholder: Recognize it as a current AWS security capability included __________.

reveal.text: Recognize it as a current AWS security capability included in exam-guide version 1.1.

prompts.label: 🧠 MENTAL MODEL
prompts.placeholder: Security automation should remain auditable and __________.

reveal.text: Security automation should remain auditable and bounded by permissions.

prompts.label: 🎯 EXAM CLUE
prompts.placeholder: The exam guide added it to Skill __________.

reveal.text: The exam guide added it to Skill 4.2.5 in revision 1.1.

authoring_notes: Original learning content. Official SOA-C03 exam guide revision 1.1 is the scope authority; the supplied May 2026 study guide was used as a supplementary coverage check and was not copied. Prompt placeholders were revised in v2 so ordinary prompts directly cloze or structurally preview the revealed content. Exam-clue prompts retain certification-style scenario wording and now reveal a direct answer first.
